note: BH-5779: how many times this lane resets a lead review request that came back failed for the current head, before it raises one alert (lead-failed-<slug>-<n>-<sha12>) that names the failure reason. 0 = never reset; the first failure alerts. A failed row with detail empty (billed, no verdict) is an environment failure: when bin/lead-review-land.sh registers LEAD_REVIEW_ENV_RETRY_MAX (BH-5793), that lane requeues it and this lane does not; on a tree without that knob, this lane resets it too, under this same cap. Moved from the retired lead-review-enqueue lane (BH-5878): the worklist gates read it.
